Confidence and self esteem

Counselling to help you develop a kinder relationship with yourself

If you find yourself doubting your worth, being overly self-critical, or feeling that you are somehow not enough, counselling can help. Together we can explore where these feelings come from and begin to develop a kinder, more compassionate relationship with yourself.

Low self esteem often has deep roots — in early experiences, relationships, or messages we absorbed about ourselves a long time ago. Understanding those roots can be the first step to changing how you see and feel about yourself.

This work takes time, but it is some of the most meaningful and lasting change that counselling can bring about.
